facts.function: lifting frame attachment that lets a container spreader/crane handle over-height (open-top/flat-rack) containers
facts.form: frame attachment, a part of container-handling lifting machinery

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8431 covers parts suitable for use solely or principally with machinery of headings 8425 to 8430
Section XVI note 2(b): the frame is not itself a good of a specific heading and is used principally with container cranes, so it goes with the parts heading for those machines
GRI 6: 8431.49 (parts of 8426) > 8431.49.10 of machinery of heading 8426 > 8431.49.10.10 of 8426.11/8426.19/8426.30 cranes (assumed gantry/STS container crane)

rejected_alternatives.reason: would apply only if the attachment is for a forklift/top-handler of heading 8427; not stated
would apply if used with straddle carriers or mobile lifting frames rather than gantry/overhead cranes
the frame is an attachment/part, not a complete crane

missing_facts: Which machine is the overheight frame used with: ship-to-shore/gantry crane (8426.11/.19/.30), straddle carrier (8426.12), or a forklift/top-loader (8427)?
Is it suitable solely or principally for that machine?
classification.rationale: An overheight frame is a lifting attachment used with container-handling machinery, and under Section XVI note 2(b) such a dedicated part goes to heading 8431 with the machine it serves. N344880 classified a dedicated crane lifting beam in 8431.49.1010 as a part of 8426 cranes. The statistical line depends on whether the host machine is a gantry/STS crane, a straddle carrier or a forklift, which the description does not state, so the answer abstains.
